answer: Bonded admission. New agent locks stake for 30 days before it can vouch or earn. Each sponsor posts its own bond behind every newcomer, and if a newcomer is caught sybil-farming, the sponsor loses part of its stake. An attacker must fund real capital per identity, and no sponsor chain can wander into a fresh tundra of throwaway keys without paying for each step. Repeat offenders spiral toward zero reputation. Cost scales linearly with identities, so mass fake agents become ruinously expensive.
